abstract: In vitro exposure of a human testicular teratoma continuous cell line to fractionated X-irradiation resulted in the expression of resistance to cisplatin. In two independently-derived sublines, designated SUSA-DXR13 and SUSA-DXR10 resulting from treatment with either 13 fractions of 1.5 Gy (dose required to reduce survival by 1 log) or 10 fractions of 3 Gy (dose required to reduce survival by 2 logs) respectively, the IC50 values for cisplatin were 2- and 3.1-fold higher than that of the parental cell line. These sublines were cross-resistant to carboplatin (approximately 2-fold) but not to adriamycin and they showed unaltered radiosensitivities. The SUSA-DXR10 subline expressed some cross-resistance to mitomycin C and melphalan but none to Carmustine (BCNU). Total glutathione content was significantly reduced in both SUSA-DXR10 and SUSA-DXR13 cells, but the activities of associated enzymes, including the glutathione S-transferases, peroxidase and reductase were not modified significantly in the resistant sublines. Resistance in the SUSA-DXR10 subline was associated with significantly decreased 195mcisplatin uptake (p less than 0.01), but this was not reflected in a reduced level of drug bound to the DNA. The formation and removal of four platinum-DNA adducts were immunochemically quantitated. Immediately following drug treatment there was a higher level of total platination of the DNA in the resistant subline indicative of increased tolerance to DNA damage. After an 18 hr post treatment incubation, there was an indication of some repair capacity in this SUSA-DXR10 cell line, which was not apparent in the parental cells. Neither the parental nor the SUSA-DXR10 cell line was proficient in the repair of the major adduct Pt-GG, whereas both lines repaired the monofunctional adduct and the adduct Pt(GMP)2. SUSA-DXR10 cells were also able to repair the intrastrand adduct Pt-AG and interstrand crosslinks, unlike the repair deficient parental cells. Higher levels of interstrand crosslinks were characteristic of the SUSA-DXR10 subline. These observations therefore implicate both enhanced repair and increased tolerance of DNA damage as mechanisms of resistance to cisplatin resulting from in vitro exposure of a human teratoma cell line to fractionated X-irradiation.
abstract_ja: ヒト精巣奇形腫の連続細胞株を分割X線照射に曝露すると、シスプラチンに対する耐性が発現した。1.5Gyを13回(生存率を1log低下させる線量)で処理した亜株SUSA-DXR13と、3Gyを10回(生存率を2log低下させる線量)で処理した亜株SUSA-DXR10の2つの独立した亜株において、シスプラチンのIC50値は親株のそれぞれ2倍および3.1倍であった。これらの亜株はカルボプラチンに対しても交差耐性(約2倍)を示したが、アドリアマイシンには示さず、放射線感受性は変化しなかった。SUSA-DXR10亜株はマイトマイシンCおよびメルファランに対してもやや交差耐性を示したが、カルムスチン(BCNU)には示さなかった。総グルタチオン含量は両耐性亜株で有意に低下したが、グルタチオンS-トランスフェラーゼ、ペルオキシダーゼ、レダクターゼを含む関連酵素の活性は耐性亜株で有意な変化を示さなかった。SUSA-DXR10亜株の耐性は、195mCisplatinの取り込みの有意な減少(p<0.01)と関連していたが、DNAに結合した薬物量の減少には反映されなかった。4種の白金-DNA付加体の形成と除去を免疫化学的に定量した。薬剤処理直後は、耐性亜株でDNAの総白金化が高く、DNA損傷耐性の増加が示された。処理後18時間のインキュベーション後、SUSA-DXR10細胞株に修復能の兆候が認められたが、親株には認められなかった。親株もSUSA-DXR10株も主要付加体Pt-GGの修復には不十分であったが、両株ともモノ付加体と付加体Pt(GMP)2は修復した。SUSA-DXR10細胞は、修復欠損の親株とは異なり、鎖内付加体Pt-AGと鎖間架橋を修復できた。SUSA-DXR10亜株では鎖間架橋のレベルが高かった。これらの観察から、分割X線照射への曝露によって生じたシスプラチン耐性の機序として、修復の亢進とDNA損傷耐性の増加の両方が関与することが示唆された。
